title: 2 of 6 Broken Out of the Box
text:
2 of 6 Broken Out of the Box. I ordered this set of mugs with the intent of using them either in my office or during the holidays while family is home. They look nice and I was hopeful they would be a good set right out of the box for coffee or cocoa. Instead, I received a box of broken mugs.

These ship in a box inside a box, and the inner box has dividers to keep the mugs separated with light padding in the outer box. In spite of the protective measures, two of these mugs were broken on arrival. There was no visible damage to either box, so either these are especially fragile, they were damaged going in the box or they were dropped somewhere along the way. Regardless of the reason, I have a set that is now incomplete because 1/3 of the mugs were unusable, and if they had been packed better this would have been the case.

I cannot rate these mugs very highly at all, as I received a set that was broken before it arrived and it was avoidable with better packing.
